rain: Rain dey fall for Marlow Street, the kind rain wey dey swallow sound of footsteps.
tape: Detective Nia stand behind the yellow tape, dey watch as red and blue light dey pulse inside the narrow passage like say e dey breathe.
body: Dem don find one man for the far end, beside the old brick wall.
witness: No weapon. No wallet. Na only one witness dey: one girl wey swear say she no see anything.
witness.ask: Why the girl talk say she no see anything?
streetlight: But the streetlight above the narrow passage don dey blink all night.
not-random: Nia notice say the light no dey just blink anyhow.
pattern: E go go off for three seconds, then flash two times.
message: Again and again, like say person dey send message.
key: She follow the way the light dey blink reach the pole, come find one small brass key wey dem use tape hold under am.
door: The key fit the lock of one door wey dem don use brick block for twenty years.
door.ask: Who use brick block the door?
cupboard: Behind the bricks, one cupboard dey, and na only one photograph dey inside am.
photo: For the photograph, the girl wey be witness still small well-well, dey stand beside the man wey don missing.
truth: No be say the girl no see anything. She see everything, and she don dey wait make somebody ask the right question.
